newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 18.

text.p: The following stories was reported in Friday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - John Kluge's Metromedia International Group is consolidating its Hollywood operations under a new corporate moniker, Metromedia Entertainment Group. Orion Pictures Corp ORPC.O Chief Executive Officer Len White takes on the new title of president and chief executive officer of MEG.

HOLLYWOOD - Japanese distribution and production company Kuzui Enterprises has finalized the sale of 35 percent of its company to Culture Convenience Club, a video rental chain and investor in the planned DirecTV Japan satellite service.
LONDON - British media group Pearson Plc has named Marjorie Scardino as chief executive and Dennis Stevenson as chairman designate.
NEW YORK - Cable stocks led by Tele-Communications Inc plunged on Thursday as Time Warner Inc plans to reduce its cable holdings.
